scope_summary: Add canonical VOID lifecycle state and an Alembic revision that upgrades legacy position-status constraints without deleting historical facts.
Enable permanent-idempotency latest-event reversal for active ADD, REDUCE, and CLOSE events while reserving OPEN reversal for audited whole-position void.
Implement whole-position void by appending compensating facts and postings in reverse event order, preserving the original event and ledger audit trail.
Enforce lifecycle chronology so reopening an older lifecycle cannot cross a later same-side non-void lifecycle, with stable lifecycle-order and side-conflict errors.
Release same-side financially-open uniqueness only after full close or completed void, while permitting historical re-recording after affected lifecycles are void.
Remove VOID lifecycles from dashboard, timeline, PDF, analytics, and active lifecycle read projections without treating archive as a financial correction.
Keep legacy PATCH, delete, batch, and migration-fallback mutation surfaces fail-closed in the public API.
Expose distinct latest-event reversal and whole-position void controls in the frontend, each requiring a reason and carrying stable idempotency and request identity.
